image_description: A chestnut racehorse (sorrel) with a white blaze on its face, wearing a bridle and saddle cloth with the number 10. A jockey in turquoise and white silks is mounted on the horse. A handler in a dark jacket holds the reins near the horse's head. The background shows a grassy paddock with wooden fences, birch trees, and other horses/people in the distance. Text '© Josefine Stenudd' is visible in the top left corner.
